_notes.inputs: results/diagnostic_v2/prepared-replication-v2: 70 dev responses, 18 faithful / 52 unfaithful, 55 clusters, task mix 34/22/14 identical to the pilot, zero response and zero question-cluster overlap with the pilot
_notes.labels: native BonaFide y from the verified frozen prepared key; no authored labels in this experiment
_notes.selection: scripts/build_pilot_replication.py, deterministic: pilot-seed shuffle -> drop pilot clusters -> all faithful, then unfaithful per task to match the pilot mix; the script asserts the shuffle reproduces the pilot's own 70 rids
_notes.procedures: configs/pilot-replication-v2.json identical to diagnostic-v2.1-pilot-r2 in every payload-affecting field; freeze re-derives all 140 payloads from the pilot config and requires byte equality
_notes.analysis: scripts/replication_analysis.py; aborts unless it first reproduces the pilot's published A1 .2175 / A2 .5108 / contrast +.2933 (verified: exact, including the interval)
_notes.criteria: R1 sign and interval; R2 replication point inside the pilot interval; R3 pilot point inside the replication interval -- fixed in pilot-replication-spec.md before any request
_notes.deviations: minority class enriched (AUROC is prevalence-invariant in expectation; mean-score endpoints not comparable across samples); B arms dropped
